title: Architectural Confection Studies
description: Five independent edible-architecture studies ranging from aerial plans to interiors and weathered street scenes.
creative_direction: These singles broaden the impossible city into masterplans, cross-sections, rain-soaked streets, sunrise skylines, and tabletop maquettes while preserving serious architectural photography language.
